name: LogisPass + LogisYARD
install:
cd /agent/repos/logispass && npm ci
cd /agent/repos/logisyard && npm install

terminals.name: logispass
terminals.description: LogisPass wallet-pass studio + API on http://localhost:3000 (tsx watch). Runs in preview mode until Google Wallet credentials are provided.

terminals.name: logisyard
terminals.description: LogisYARD API on http://localhost:3001 and Vite client on http://localhost:5173. Uses an in-memory store when DATABASE_URL is unset.
